Session 13 Prep: The Council and the Wall

Continues from: Session 12 Summary Arc: start of Phase 6, The Evil Queen's Reckoning Estimated Length: 2 hours 40 minutes including a 10-minute break; the optional seventh scene adds 15–20. Asset Checklist: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.8e4f149331ff0974]{session13 asset checklist} Castle at the table: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cde61798bfdf1c71]{Rosehold} · @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls}

This session is the unplayed half of session 12 carried forward and adjusted, then the castle's first level. Session 12 skipped the camp fight, the black tent, the knighthoods, Aurelius and the muster; the party fought Embra in the cave instead, Sir Raphael killed her, and Tawny died. What changed is listed under "Carried forward" below.

1. Where Session 12 Left Off

From 00 campaign state: The Princess and the Dragon is over. Princess Amy is back in her own body and travelling with the party to break the barrier, since it takes her magic and Aurelius's together. Embra is dead, killed in her dragon body by Sir Raphael the Lucky, who has taken the glory and the money and is retiring as the Dragon Killer. Tawny was killed in the fight; Filly's new companion is @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.420ce96ef2fb0f2c]{Major Ursa}, a polar bear, and she keeps Tawny's silver claws and teeth. The Dragonfilch Curse is over for everyone. The party is level 4, healed for the castle, and rich enough that nobody counts money; the players were asked to design special items and send them to the GM. The party is in the dragon's cave while the knights celebrate Raphael. Finnian was fooled and never learned the truth; Damon, Ulrik, Stella and the black tent were never found.

Party, from campaign state

PC Player Where they stand in the story
Princess Filly skeptica Lost Tawny to Embra. New companion Major Ursa ("Major"), a polar bear; keeps Tawny's silver claws and teeth. Talked the false Amy into walking to her own undoing. Still wears the Swan's Grace Pendant and Spectacles of Discernment, now curse-free. Wants a teleportation item.
Prince Vega spyro01 Cracked the dragon's scales with Vein-Breaker; was knocked out by her fire. Keeps Blitzenaxt, curse-free. The party's voice of restraint ("we weren't going to kill Amy").
Princess Marigold 11de784a Back with the party. Started the fight by grabbing Embra's purse, healed Amy back onto her feet, and taunted the dragon. Keeps the Dragonfire Shield, curse-free. Still unexplained: the whisper calling her south.

Carried forward from session 12, and what changed

Session 12 scene (unplayed) Now Change
4. The Black Tent Scene 1 Finnian brings the paper signed M. and the thorn. Amy, not Embra, remembers the hooded man and the necklaces
6. Knighthoods Scene 1 Same knighting; Major Ursa is knighted, not Tawny. No SP award (money is no longer tracked). Level 4 is already applied
6. Aurelius arrives Scene 1 Arrives at the cave
7. The Muster Scenes 2–3 Sir Finnian is now an ally (Amy convinced him). Raphael is famous. The pups look for Tawny. New workshop beat for the players' special items
3. Camp fight, 5. The Key Turns Dropped Played differently in session 12

Before opening

  • [ ] Collect the players' special-item designs (the GM's homework from session 12) and decide on each. They are handed over in scene 3.

  • [ ] Decide each PC's +3 Armor dragon-scale item if not already done.

  • [ ] Make a Major Ursa actor (@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.420ce96ef2fb0f2c]{Major Ursa}: HP 8, SAVE 10, Armor 2, Bite d10 and Claws d6) using the finished art: npcs/assets/major ursa.png and npcs/assets/major ursa token.png. Retire Tawny's token.

  • [ ] Add Sir Finnian to the Ally Calls journal in Foundry, and swap Tawny for Major Ursa in the crystal wolves' call (vault @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls} is updated).

  • [ ] Blank @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker}: Cold at 0.

2. Session Flow Cheat Sheet

SESSION 13 — THE COUNCIL AND THE WALL                    160 minutes
ACT I: THE CAVE
  1. The Dragon Killer's Feast                           25 min
     (Tawny laid to rest, Finnian and the paper signed M.,
      knighthoods, Aurelius)
  2. The Road North                                      10 min
ACT II: THE COUNCIL
  3. The Council Below Rosehold                          35 min
     (reunion, workshop, Ally Calls, way in, the speech)
  ☕ BREAK                                               10 min
ACT III: THE WALL
  4. The Frozen Causeway                                 15 min
  5. The Barrier of Thorns                               30 min
  6. The Gatehouse (Hilde)                               25 min
  7. OPTIONAL: The Court of Frozen Fountains             15–20 min

Total: 150 minutes for scenes 1–6 plus the break, about 170 with scene 7. If scene 3 runs long, cut scene 2 to one read-aloud. If the party takes Bannik's tunnel or Puca's catapult, scenes 4–6 are replaced by a short arrival in scene 3; end there.

Spotlight opportunities

  • ⭐ Filly: what she does for Tawny; Major Ursa's first fight, in front of Amy; the wolf pups looking for Tawny; Tawny's dream knight in the thorn's smell.

  • ⭐ Vega: Tawny's cairn; the red mud on the thorn; talking the trees off the causeway; Vein-Breaker on the Construct.

  • ⭐ Marigold: the staff pulling north; her bubble on Amy at the Barrier; standing between Hilde and a friend; the fountain that recharges her staff.

3. Detailed Scene Menu

Order Scene note Time Use
1 The Dragon Killer's Feast 25 min Opening. Tawny; Finnian learns the truth and brings M. and ROSEHOLD; knighthoods; Aurelius
2 The Road North 10 min Montage; one question per player; first sight of the wall
3 The Council Below Rosehold 35 min Allies, special items, Ally Calls, way in, the Braveheart speech
☕ Break 10 min No in-fiction time passes
4 The Frozen Causeway 15 min Cold starts at 0; the Awakened Trees
5 The Barrier of Thorns 30 min Three-round set piece; the rose over the gate
6 The Gatehouse 25 min Construct and Hilde; first whisper
7 The Court of Frozen Fountains 15–20 min Optional continuation into Level 1

Foundry scene quick reference

Scene Foundry scene / setup
1 Your existing Dragon's Cave (fallback module Dragon Cave Lair)
2 Module Scorchwoods — The Road Beyond, then Castle Approach
3 Module Castle Approach, or Rosehold 0 — The Thornwall at A1
4–6 Rosehold 0 — The Thornwall (staged 2026-10-10)
7 Rosehold 1 — The Outer Ward

4. NPC Quick Reference

NPC Play them as Useful limit or offer
Amy Kind, braver than she thinks, a little giddy to be herself HP 6, SAVE 12. Breaks the wall with Aurelius. Will not fight. Inside or at the breach: the players choose
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.5b4d496cc81a50b5]{Sir Finnian} Vain, loud, sincerely brave, newly humbled Brings the paper signed M. Now an Ally Call
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.b71f496a108e185d]{Sir Raphael} Famous by accident, composing Knows who did the work. Still answers a call: "a ballad needs a sequel"
Aurelius Grave; he knew the castle Carries Amy. Holds the breach. Once: all Heart Dice restored
Daisy Brisk, relieved, out of her depth Promotes the party to Field Operative. Does not know about the rose
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.87ad7c19cda317ad]{Pippin} Fussy craftsman with an invoice Hands over the special items
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.420ce96ef2fb0f2c]{Major Ursa} Solemn, enormous, keen New. Earns his place; does not inherit Tawny's
@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-actors.Actor.bc542089c3cb8e63]{Hilde} Loyal past the point of sense Freed by the pin and a RESOLVE test; "You're late"

5. GM Tools

The Cold

Starts at 0 on the causeway. Tell the players it exists. +1 for a loud fight in the open or a forced door; −1 when an Echo is freed. At 2 she notices (patrols double, she starts speaking). Full track: @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.fa6597afb86e582d]{rosehold runbook} section 3; record on @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker}.

d6 complications at the wall (use one if a scene is flat)

From @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.cdb134b8dd87d595]{Rosehold Wrinkles}, filtered for Level 0. Each also raises the Cold by 1.

d6 Complication
1 Patrol. Four Thornsworn and a sergeant on the gatehouse wall. One round to hide, bluff or strike first.
2 Wisps. d4+1 Frostbind Wisps drift through the ice toward whoever last spent a Heart Die.
3 The thorns move. Black briars creep across the path behind the party. Cut through, burn through, or go round.
4 A mirror wakes. The ice shows the Queen's face. One line to one hero (@UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1e4073f222b2931e]{Rosehold Whispers}); WITS or Befuddled.
5 Glass ravens. 2d4 at the gatehouse arrow-slits. Any that escape raise the Cold again.
6 Deep frost. RESOLVE or Weary until a warm room. Torch-bearers and anyone wearing Mama Bear's amulet have advantage.

d10 whispers

Use @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.1e4073f222b2931e]{Rosehold Whispers} whenever the Cold rises. Best for tonight: 1 ("You wear my pin. Did they tell you who made it?"), 6 (the unicorn), 7 ("That girl outside thinks friendship is a kind of light. It is. Lights go out."), 3 to Filly, 5 to Marigold.

Rewards, only when earned

Thing How Note
Honorary knighthoods Amy, scene 1 Title. Major Ursa too
Field Operative rank Daisy, scene 3 Can command the Society's people on the mountain
Special items The workshop, scene 3 As approved by the GM
Ally Calls (two each) Scene 3 Record on the tracker
Hilde's Buckler + first whisper Freeing Hilde, scene 6 Cold −1; one Vow Pillar gone

6. Handout Prep

No handouts to prepare. Read aloud from the scene notes:

  • The paper under the thorn (scene 1): first appearance of M. and ROSEHOLD.

  • The @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.a1d4390573d3737d]{Ally Calls} table (scene 3): player-safe; paste into chat if you like.

Do not share the runbook, the level notes, or any _gm floor plan.

7. Potential Session End Points

  1. ⭐ Recommended: the gate swings open on the Court of Frozen Fountains (end of scene 6). Hilde freed, calls chosen, Cold recorded.
  2. If running early: the Queen's voice from the fountain ice (end of scene 7).
  3. If the council runs long: the Barrier breaks and the rose is uncovered (end of scene 5). Open session 14 at the gatehouse.
  4. If the party goes under or over: arrival in the Cistern or on the Raven Tower (scene 3, "If they don't take the gate").

At close record on @UUID[Compendium.pnp-end-game.pnp-endgame-journals.JournalEntry.168a20ce123acb41]{rosehold tracker}: the Cold, each PC's Ally Calls, the way in, whether Amy came inside, Hilde freed or destroyed and who holds the buckler, and the special items handed over.
